metadata.title: That 1 kill where I swear the enemy just AFK’d mid-peek LOL Valorant logic again
metadata.description:
Wait, I didn’t even aim and got a kill?
Enemy must’ve been on a snack break.
This is why I never trust my own skill.
Valorant just handing out freebies like candy.

Tap if your kills come with zero effort but max chaos!

#valorant #gamingfails #luckshot #funnygaming #shorts
